# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'grpc'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module TenantIsolation
  class TenantContext
    attr_reader :tenant_id, :permissions, :resource_scope

    def initialize(tenant_id:, permissions:, resource_scope:)
      @tenant_id = tenant_id
      @permissions = permissions
      @resource_scope = resource_scope
      freeze
    end

    def authorized_for?(resource)
      return false unless resource.respond_to?(:tenant_id)
      resource.tenant_id == @tenant_id
    end
  end

  class ResourceHandle
    attr_accessor :tenant_id, :resource_type, :resource_id, :payload

    def initialize(tenant_id:, resource_type:, resource_id:, payload: nil)
      @tenant_id = tenant_id
      @resource_type = resource_type
      @resource_id = resource_id
      @payload = payload
    end

    def composite_key
      "#{@tenant_id}:#{@resource_type}:#{@resource_id}"
    end
  end

  class PolicyEngine
    ADMIN_SCOPE = :global
    TENANT_SCOPE = :tenant

    def evaluate_access(context, handle)
      return :deny unless context.is_a?(TenantContext)
      return :deny unless handle.is_a?(ResourceHandle)

      scope_check = check_scope(context, handle)
      return :deny unless scope_check

      :allow
    end

    private

    def check_scope(context, handle)
      case context.resource_scope
      when ADMIN_SCOPE
        true
      when TENANT_SCOPE
        context.authorized_for?(handle)
      else
        false
      end
    end
  end

  class MetadataParser
    def self.extract_tenant_context(metadata)
      raw_context = metadata['x-tenant-context']
      return nil unless raw_context

      parsed = deserialize_context(raw_context)
      return nil unless parsed

      build_context(parsed)
    end

    def self.deserialize_context(raw)
      data = JSON.parse(raw, symbolize_names: true)
      validate_schema(data) ? data : nil
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      nil
    end

    def self.validate_schema(data)
      required = %i[tenant_id permissions resource_scope]
      required.all? { |k| data.key?(k) }
    end

    def self.build_context(data)
      scope = resolve_scope(data[:resource_scope])
      TenantContext.new(
        tenant_id: data[:tenant_id].to_s,
        permissions: Array(data[:permissions]),
        resource_scope: scope
      )
    end

    def self.resolve_scope(scope_value)
      case scope_value
      when 'global', :global
        PolicyEngine::ADMIN_SCOPE
      when 'tenant', :tenant
        PolicyEngine::TENANT_SCOPE
      else
        scope_value.to_sym
      end
    end
  end

  class ResourceService < GRPC::GenericService
    self.marshal_class_method = :encode
    self.unmarshal_class_method = :decode
    self.service_name = 'tenant_isolation.ResourceService'

    rpc :GetResource, GetResourceRequest, GetResourceResponse
    rpc :UpdateResource, UpdateResourceRequest, UpdateResourceResponse
  end

  class ResourceServiceHandler < ResourceService::Service
    def initialize(store:, policy_engine: PolicyEngine.new)
      @store = store
      @policy_engine = policy_engine
    end

    def get_resource(request, call)
      context = MetadataParser.extract_tenant_context(call.metadata)
      return permission_denied unless context

      handle = @store.lookup(request.resource_id)
      return not_found unless handle

      decision = @policy_engine.evaluate_access(context, handle)
      return permission_denied unless decision == :allow

      build_response(handle)
    end

    def update_resource(request, call)
      context = MetadataParser.extract_tenant_context(call.metadata)
      return permission_denied unless context

      handle = @store.lookup(request.resource_id)
      return not_found unless handle

      decision = @policy_engine.evaluate_access(context, handle)
      return permission_denied unless decision == :allow

      handle.payload = request.payload
      @store.save(handle)
      build_update_response(handle)
    end

    private

    def permission_denied
      raise GRPC::PermissionDenied.new('Access denied')
    end

    def not_found
      raise GRPC::NotFound.new('Resource not found')
    end

    def build_response(handle)
      GetResourceResponse.new(
        resource_id: handle.resource_id,
        tenant_id: handle.tenant_id,
        payload: handle.payload
      )
    end

    def build_update_response(handle)
      UpdateResourceResponse.new(
        resource_id: handle.resource_id,
        success: true
      )
    end
  end
end
